# HALF 1 – The claim and its reproduction {#half-1-the-claim-and-its-reproduction .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
First half
:::

::: notes
The first half starts with the vocabulary of three kinds of repetition and with the large studies that measured how often findings survive each of them, one of which supplies our case study. Then comes the case study itself, an experiment run by email, with its claim. We work out which question the claim answers and draw a causal graph of the experiment, which brings out a problem that is easy to miss. Before the break you reproduce the result reported by one of the five independent analysts of this claim, the one that I give you, and find out why your number comes out exactly as it does.
:::
